thought.text: VPS hat Array-Version! Lass mich VPS ObserverEngine checken:

reasoning_content: The VPS WorldTick has `.map()` on `observedChunks`, which expects it to be an array. But the method returns `{ ids, chunks }`, not an array! This is a bug introduced somewhere. Let me check the VPS ObserverEngine to see what it returns vs the local:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -A 20 'getObservedChunks' /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/observer/ObserverEngine.ts | head -25")
print("VPS ObserverEngine:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
